news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics to Announce Financial Results for the Second Quarter on Thursday, August 13, 2026, After Close of U.S.-Based Financial Markets
news.summary: Nektar confirmed it will report second-quarter 2026 financial results after U.S. market close on Thursday, August 13, 2026, with President and CEO Howard Robin hosting a conference call and webcast beginning at 5:00 p.m. ET to review results.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics (NASDAQ:NKTR) Coverage Initiated at Canaccord Genuity Group
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity initiated coverage of Nektar with a Buy rating and a $153 price target, citing the commercial potential of rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis and alopecia areata, contrasting with Wedbush's more cautious $80 Neutral target set in May over concerns about Dupixent's entrenched market position.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program Evaluating Novel Regulatory T-Cell Biologic Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar dosed the first patients in ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2, the first two of three global, randomized, placebo-controlled Phase 3 trials of rezpegaldesleukin in patients 12+ with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis. A third trial, ZENITH AD-3, targeting patients with prior biologic/JAK inhibitor experience, is planned to begin in September 2026.

news.headline: NKTR Stock Clocks Best Day In Over 2 Months As Investors Await Upcoming Clinical Data In Eczema
news.summary: Nektar shares jumped roughly 5% to as high as $75.87 in its best single-day move in over two months, driven by investor anticipation ahead of upcoming atopic dermatitis (eczema) clinical developments for rezpegaldesleukin.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Stock Climbs As Immunology Sentiment Improves
news.summary: NKTR shares rose about 10.6% as sentiment across inflammation-and-immunology biotech names improved, with Canaccord flagging Nektar as a beneficiary of read-through from AbbVie's prospective acquisition of Apogee Therapeutics.

news.headline: Does Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR) Straddling Russell Growth and Value Indexes Reveal a Conflicted Narrative?
news.summary: Nektar was added to a wide suite of Russell indexes (Russell 2000, 2500, 3000 and associated growth/value benchmarks) in the annual Russell reconstitution, expanding its presence across small-cap and broad-market index funds.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Nektar will report second-quarter 2026 financial results after U.S. market close on Thursday, August 13, 2026, with CEO Howard Robin hosting a webcast at 5:00 p.m. ET to review results.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 trial initiation
catalysts.detail: The third and final trial of the pivotal Phase 3 ZENITH AD program (enrolling atopic dermatitis patients with prior biologic/JAK inhibitor experience) is planned to begin.

catalysts.label: REZOLVE-AD 36-week maintenance data presentation
catalysts.detail: Nektar plans to present additional 36-week maintenance data from the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD study, including durability of response on lowered dosing, at a medical conference in the second half of 2026; exact date/venue not yet confirmed.

catalysts.label: REZOLVE-AA 24-week off-treatment topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline data from the 24-week off-treatment follow-up period of the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata study are expected, building on the positive 36-week on-treatment results reported earlier in 2026.

catalysts.label: Alopecia areata Phase 3 trial initiation
catalysts.detail: Based on positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA data, Nektar plans to initiate a single registrational Phase 3 trial of rezpegaldesleukin in alopecia areata.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline data / BLA
catalysts.detail: Initial topline results from the Phase 3 ZENITH AD atopic dermatitis program are targeted for mid-2028, with a BLA submission planned for 2029.

pulse: Nektar's stock has cooled slightly from its July highs after the July 21 start of the pivotal Phase 3 ZENITH AD program in atopic dermatitis, even as Wall Street sentiment stays broadly constructive: Canaccord initiated coverage at Buy ($153 target) on July 22, contrasting with Wedbush's more cautious $80 Neutral stance on concerns Dupixent's entrenched position could limit rezpeg's first-line uptake. The company confirmed Q2 2026 earnings for August 13, 2026, the next major scheduled catalyst, with additional REZOLVE-AD and REZOLVE-AA data readouts expected later in 2026 ahead of a planned alopecia areata Phase 3 start in early 2027. Nektar remains well capitalized following its April $373.8M offering and was recently added to a suite of Russell indexes, broadening its institutional ownership base.
